query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN description LIKE '%Hong Kong%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as hong_kong,
  SUM(CASE WHEN description LIKE '%HK%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as hk_ref,
  SUM(CASE WHEN description LIKE '%hong kong%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as lowercase_hk
FROM equipment_items 
WHERE description LIKE '%Hong Kong%' OR description LIKE '%hong kong%';
